exact_statement: For all n>=1,a>=0, binary linear M:F2^n->F2^a and quadratic q with q(0)=0, F*=(b(x)-2*1_(x=0))y_(Mx), b=(-1)^q, is Boolean. With r=rank M, D=n-r and k=polar rank on ker M, H(F*)=2r+k+2^(-r)(E_(D,k)-k), where E_(D,k) is the entropy of masses (2^(-k/2)-2^(1-D))^2,(2^(-k/2)+2^(1-D))^2,2^(2-2D) with respective counts (2^k+2^(k/2))/2,(2^k-2^(k/2))/2,2^D-2^k, omitting zero masses. Active M-column controls have influence 1/2; each inactive control influence changes from the quadratic baseline by (1-2*l_i)2^(1-n); total data influence is one. If q has zero linear term, a physical tree querying active address controls then remaining quadratic interactions has B_i<=2Inf_i at every internal node, so its localized boundary bill at K=2 is zero, with quadratic and point-defect terminals paying H(F*)<=4(I(F*)-1). For matching q on even n and fixed prefix rank r, H/I tends to 2, while the unlocalized root boundary bill/I grows linearly in n.
hypotheses: uniform independent physical binary controls and distinct data signs
entropy in bits, total physical influence; real derivative I(D) is Fourier Dirichlet energy
q quadratic with q(0)=0 for exact surgery identities; zero linear q required only for the stated stopping theorem
distinct address labels name distinct physical y_z coordinates; arbitrary control reuse computing M is allowed
fixed-r limit and explicit root-charge comparison use even-n matching quadratic and prefix coordinate address

locators: Physical stopping tree with zero bad-node boundary bill
